show.description: A gritty transformation-and-revenge saga where gaming ignites destiny. Vicky, burdened by hardship and an ailing grandfather, finds escape in a gaming rig he builds from scraps. Online, he becomes ShadowMaster - unbeatable, untouchable. Offline, he rises from humiliation to challenge Vikram, the ruthless businessman who stole his love and became his biggest enemy. This is Vicky’s journey - from pain to power, from nobody to billionaire. Watch Now!
